adjuster_notes: Police report #2024-CPD-12094 on file. Forced entry damage to sliding door confirmed, though photos submitted by renter show some inconsistencies in the positioning of displaced items between initial and follow-up documentation. Renters policy covers personal property theft up to policy limit. Claim approved for personal property replacement at $1,200 after deductible. Sliding door repair is landlord responsibility. Flagged for photo inconsistency review but approved based on confirmed forced entry and police report.
description: The renter reported a forced entry through the ground-floor sliding glass door while they were away at work. The sliding door's lock was pried and the door forced off its track. A laptop, gaming console, jewelry, and a small safe containing personal documents were reported stolen from the living room and bedroom. The renter filed a police report the same evening upon returning home and discovering the break-in.
